timing_scope: Prompt activation tokens saved to disk after warmup, including capture, transfer, writes, backpressure and final drain; excludes model startup, warmup and numerical comparison.
precision: BF16; not the matched FP32 operator profile
caveats: Requested batch sizes are admission limits; actual vLLM forward batches can be split by scheduling.
All four methods at batches 8,16,32,64 use the same GPU UUID.
Batch 128 sibling methods resumed on a different H200; not used for the report headline.
These receipts measure package 1.0.0 source, with source hashes retained; they are not a benchmark of the current modified checkout.
Methods have different publication and finite-value checking behavior; timing does not isolate the cause of performance differences.
Every vLLM method passes only 3/18 strict sites against Transformers; speed does not establish numerical interchangeability.
One timing workload per method/batch; no confidence intervals or run-to-run variability estimate.
